topic_ko: 전자레인지 사례 — 하루로는 안 보이지만 쌓여 가는 변화
_note: 유형별 묶음 구조. 같은 34번 지문이라도 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase 한다.

passage: When our attention settles on what is conspicuous about a new medium, the quiet shifts escape us entirely.
Most people register the striking features of a technology and overlook its finer effects.
The microwave oven, introduced in the early 1980s, offers a clear illustration.
Before it appeared, one household member usually gave up most of an afternoon to prepare the evening meal.
Suddenly food could be ready in minutes, which felt genuinely freeing for the family cooks, most of them women.
That plain gain in convenience made the slower consequence easy to ignore.
Once nobody prepared a single shared dinner, families gradually stopped gathering at the table.
Long-cooked meals turned into an occasional luxury, and nobody had predicted any of it.
choices: why household technologies improved most rapidly during the 1980s
how convenience has made modern families healthier than before
why women benefited more than men from new kitchen appliances
how gradual, invisible effects of technology escape our notice
why families should return to traditional methods of cooking
theme.explanation_ko: 명백한 편리함에 집중하느라 시간이 지나며 쌓이는 미묘한 변화를 놓친다는 것이 주제이다. 전자레인지는 그 사례이다. ④가 정답.
theme.distractor_ko: ①기술 발전 속도, ②건강 개선, ③성별 이익 비교, ⑤전통 요리 회귀는 본문의 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should not judge a new technology only by the benefits we can see immediately.
Most people notice a device's obvious features while missing its quieter effects.
The microwave oven, which arrived in the early 1980s, shows why this matters.
It freed family cooks, most of them women, from long afternoons of preparation.
That visible benefit made a slower consequence very easy to ignore.
Once no one prepared a single shared meal, families gradually stopped eating together.
Long-cooked dinners became an occasional luxury rather than an everyday event.
When we adopt a new tool, we should ask what it may quietly change over many years.
choices: 가정에서는 전자레인지 사용을 줄이고 전통 조리법으로 돌아가야 한다.
요리 부담은 가족 구성원이 성별에 관계없이 나누어 맡아야 한다.
새로운 기술은 즉각적 이점만이 아니라 오랜 시간 뒤의 변화까지 따져 보아야 한다.
가족은 하루 한 끼는 반드시 함께 먹는 규칙을 세워야 한다.
기술의 장기적 영향은 예측이 불가능하므로 미리 걱정할 필요가 없다.
claim.explanation_ko: 눈에 보이는 편리함만 보고 판단하면 서서히 쌓이는 변화를 놓치므로, 장기적 영향까지 함께 따져야 한다는 주장이다. ③이 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①전통 회귀, ②가사 분담, ④식사 규칙, ⑤예측 포기는 본문 주장과 다르다.

passage: Focusing on a medium's obvious features hides the changes that build up quietly over years.
Most of us see the striking aspects of a new technology and miss the finer ones.
Consider the microwave oven, which reached homes in the early 1980s.
Before it, one person typically spent most of an afternoon making the family's dinner.
Afterwards, meals took minutes, and the family cooks felt genuinely freed.
That clear benefit made the slower consequence easy to overlook.
Year by year, fewer households sat down to a shared evening meal.
No one had anticipated that the appliance would reshape family life in this way.
choices: 기술 발전은 언제나 가정생활을 더 편리하고 풍요롭게 만든다.
명백한 이점에 가려 서서히 누적되는 변화는 알아채기 어렵다.
전자레인지의 등장은 여성의 사회 진출을 결정적으로 앞당겼다.
가족 식사의 감소는 주로 근무 시간의 증가 때문에 일어났다.
새로운 기술은 도입 초기에 대부분 사회적 저항에 부딪힌다.
gist.explanation_ko: 명백한 편리함에 시선이 쏠려 시간에 걸쳐 쌓이는 변화를 놓친다는 것이 요지이다. ②가 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①기술 낙관론, ③여성의 사회 진출, ④근무 시간, ⑤기술 저항은 본문의 요지가 아니다.

passage: What is conspicuous about a medium tends to hide what changes slowly beneath it.
Most people notice the striking features of a new technology and miss the subtle ones.
The microwave oven arrived in the early 1980s and transformed how meals were made.
One household member had once spent most of an afternoon preparing the evening meal.
Now food was ready within minutes, which felt liberating for the family cooks.
That obvious convenience made the slower consequence easy to overlook.
As the years passed, fewer and fewer families gathered for a shared dinner.
The appliance reshaped family life in ways that nobody had foreseen.
choices: Faster Meals, Healthier Families: The Microwave Story
How the 1980s Changed the American Kitchen Forever
Cooking Together: A Guide to Reviving Family Dinners
Why Technology Predictions Almost Always Turn Out Right
Invisible by the Day, Enormous by the Decade
title.explanation_ko: 하루로는 보이지 않지만 수십 년에 걸쳐 거대해지는 변화를 압축한 ⑤가 제목으로 가장 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①건강 증진, ②주방의 역사, ③가족 식사 회복 지침, ④예측의 정확성은 글의 초점이 아니다.

passage: The obvious features of a medium draw our eyes away from its quieter effects.
The microwave oven, introduced in the early 1980s, changed how meals were prepared.
One person had once spent most of an afternoon making the family's evening meal.
Now dinner took minutes, and the family cooks felt genuinely freed from that burden.
The visible gain made the slower consequence easy to ignore.
The change came in at the pace of a shadow crossing a floor.
Year after year, fewer families sat down together for an evening meal.
Long-cooked dinners became a luxury reserved for special occasions.
implication.underlined: at the pace of a shadow crossing a floor
choices: so quickly that nobody had any time to react to it
only in households that had already begun to change
so slowly that no single day revealed the difference
in a way that darkened the atmosphere of family life
at different speeds in different parts of the country
implication.explanation_ko: '바닥을 가로지르는 그림자의 속도로'라는 비유는 하루하루로는 알아챌 수 없을 만큼 느리게 진행되었다는 뜻이다. ③이 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①급속한 변화, ②일부 가정 한정, ④분위기의 어두움, ⑤지역별 속도 차이는 비유의 의미와 다르다.

passage: When we focus on the obvious aspects of media, we miss the changes that accumulate over time.

The microwave oven was introduced in the early 1980s and revolutionized food preparation.
Traditionally, one person spent the better part of an afternoon to fix an evening meal.
Now it was possible to prepare foods very quickly, which felt liberating for the family cooks.
But the obvious implications of convenience made it easy to overlook the long-term ones.
As time went on, fewer and fewer families sat down together to eat dinner.

②

grammar.distractor_ko: ①선행사 the changes를 받는 주격 that, ②while이 남은 분사구문 missing, ③수동태 was introduced, ⑤make의 가목적어 it은 모두 옳다.

passage: When we focus on the obvious aspects of media, we miss the changes that accumulate over time.

This shortening of preparation time was burdensome for the cooks in the family.
But the obvious implications of convenience made it easy to overlook the long-term ones.

choices: ①

vocab.explanation_ko: ④ 준비 시간이 줄어든 것은 요리하는 사람에게 '해방감을 주는(liberating)' 일이었다. burdensome(부담스러운)은 정반대이므로 liberating으로 고쳐야 한다. ④가 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①accumulate(쌓이다), ②subtle(미묘한), ③revolutionized(혁명을 일으켰다), ⑤overlook(간과하다)은 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

sentences: The microwave oven, introduced in the early 1980s, completely revolutionized the way meals were prepared.
Traditionally, one family member had spent the better part of an afternoon fixing an evening meal.
The shortening of preparation time felt liberating for the family cooks, most of whom tended to be women.
Engineers have since developed ovens that use significantly less electricity than the earliest commercial models.
Yet as time went on, fewer and fewer families sat down together to eat an evening meal.
choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '눈에 띄지 않게 누적되는 사회적 변화'를 다루는데 ④ '전자레인지의 전력 효율 개선'은 기술 사양 이야기로 흐름을 끊는 무관한 문장이다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③⑤는 모두 전자레인지가 가져온 편리함과 그 뒤의 가족 식사 감소로 이어진다.

order.given: When we focus on the obvious aspects of media, we miss the changes that accumulate over time but are not apparent day to day.

blocks.A: But that obvious gain in convenience made it easy to overlook what would follow once no one prepared a single meal for the family to share.
blocks.B: Take the microwave oven, introduced in the early 1980s: before it, one person spent most of an afternoon fixing dinner, and afterwards food was ready in minutes, which felt liberating for the family cooks.
blocks.C: As time went on, fewer and fewer families sat down together, and long-cooked meals became a luxury of the past that nobody had foreseen.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 주제문을 (B)가 전자레인지 사례로 구체화하고, (A)가 But으로 간과된 장기적 함의를 짚으며, (C)가 As time went on으로 누적된 결과를 보여 준다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 But은 (B)의 편리함을 받아야 하고, (C)는 누적 결과이므로 마지막이어야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: But the short-term, obvious implications of greater convenience made it easy to overlook the long-term implications.

passage_marked.text: Most of us notice the obvious aspects of a new medium or technology while missing the more subtle aspects.
Take, for example, the microwave oven, which was introduced in the early 1980s and revolutionized food preparation.
Traditionally, one person spent the better part of an afternoon fixing an evening meal for a family.
Now it was possible to prepare foods very quickly, and this shortening of preparation time was liberating for the cooks in the family.
As time went on, fewer and fewer families sat down together to eat dinner.

choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 But은 앞에서 제시된 '편리함이라는 단기 이점'을 받아야 하고, 뒤에는 그 장기적 결과인 가족 식사 감소가 이어져야 한다. ④가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 문장이 없으면 편리함에서 가족 식사 감소로 곧장 넘어가 논리 연결이 끊긴다.

passage: The conspicuous features of a new medium draw attention away from its quieter effects.
The microwave oven, introduced in the early 1980s, transformed how meals were made.
One person had once spent most of an afternoon preparing the family's evening meal.
Now food was ready in minutes, which felt liberating for the family cooks.
That visible convenience made the slower consequence easy to overlook.
Once nobody prepared a shared meal, families gradually stopped gathering at the table.
Long-cooked dinners became a luxury reserved for special occasions.
None of this had been anticipated when the appliance first arrived.
summary.summary_template: Because the microwave's __(A)__ benefits captured everyone's attention, the way it slowly __(B)__ the shared family dinner went unnoticed for years.
summary.explanation_ko: 전자레인지의 (A)immediate(즉각적) 이점에 시선이 쏠려, 그것이 가족 공동 식사를 서서히 (B)eroded(무너뜨린) 과정은 오랫동안 눈에 띄지 않았다. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 hidden이나 costly가 아니라 immediate이고, (B)는 restored·protected·revealed가 아니라 eroded여야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 시간이 지나면서 함께 앉아 저녁을 먹는 가족은 점점 더 줄어들었다.
writing.answer: As time went on, fewer and fewer families sat down together to eat dinner.
writing.explanation_ko: 비교급 반복 fewer and fewer로 점진적 감소를 나타낸다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 준비하는 데 오랜 시간이 걸리는 식사는 과거의 사치가 되었다.
writing.answer: Meals that took a long time to prepare became a luxury of the past.
writing.explanation_ko: 주격 관계대명사 that이 Meals를 수식하고, take + 시간 + to V 구문이 쓰였다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 전통적으로 한 사람이 가족을 위한 저녁 식사를 준비하는 데 오후의 상당 부분을 썼다.
conditions: spend + 시간 + 동명사 구문을 사용할 것
the better part of를 사용할 것
writing.answer: Traditionally, one person spent the better part of an afternoon fixing an evening meal for a family.
writing.explanation_ko: spend + 시간 + -ing 구문과 the better part of(~의 상당 부분)를 활용한다.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: We miss the changes that ___________ over time but are not apparent day to day.

writing.question: 다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말을 쓰시오.
writing.summary: The (A)___________ convenience of the microwave oven drew all our attention, so the (B)___________ effects it had on shared family meals went unnoticed for years.
writing.explanation_ko: 명백한(obvious) 편리함에 시선이 쏠려 미묘한(subtle) 영향은 오랫동안 눈에 띄지 않았다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: The effects of the microwave oven on family life were not anticipated and would have been difficult to foresee.
writing.answer: 전자레인지가 가정생활에 미친 영향은 예상되지 않았고 예견하기도 어려웠을 것이다.
writing.explanation_ko: would have p.p.는 과거 상황에 대한 추측을 나타내며, be difficult to V는 tough 구문이다.
